lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਏ ਅਪਣਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਖੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh mue apanaa janam khoi ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs waste away their lives, and die.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur seve bharam chukaae ||
lines.translation: Serving the True Guru, doubt is driven away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: ghar hee a(n)dar sach mahal paae ||9||
lines.translation: Deep within the home of the heart, one finds the Mansion of the True Lord's Presence. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape pooraa kare s hoi ||
lines.translation: Whatever the Perfect Lord does, that alone happens.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹਿ ਥਿਤੀ ਵਾਰ ਦੂਜਾ ਦੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ehi thitee vaar doojaa doi ||
lines.translation: Concern with these omens and days leads only to duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur baajhahu a(n)dh gubaar ||
lines.translation: Without the True Guru, there is only pitch darkness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਥਿਤੀ ਵਾਰ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਮੁਗਧ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: thitee vaar sevahi mugadh gavaar ||
lines.translation: Only idiots and fools worry about these omens and days.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh boojhai sojhee paai ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh obtains understanding and realization;

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਤੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧੦॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ikat naam sadaa rahiaa samaai ||10||2||
lines.translation: he remains forever merged in the Name of the One Lord. ||10||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਛੰਤ ਦਖਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 1 chha(n)t dakhanee ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, First Mehl, Chhant, Dakhnee:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਧ ਨਵੇਲੜੀਆ ਗੋਇਲਿ ਆਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: mu(n)dh navelaReeaa goil aaee raam ||
lines.translation: The young, innocent soul-bride has come to the pasture lands of the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਟੁਕੀ ਡਾਰਿ ਧਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: matukee daar dharee har liv laaee raam ||
lines.translation: Laying aside her pitcher of worldly concern, she lovingly attunes herself to her Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹੀ ਗੋਇਲਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: liv laai har siu rahee goil sahaj sabad seegaareeaa ||
lines.translation: She remains lovingly absorbed in the pasture of the Lord, automatically embellished with the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਿਆਰੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar joR gur pahi kar bina(n)tee milahu saach piaareeaa ||
lines.translation: With her palms pressed together, she prays to the Guru, to unite her with her True Beloved Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan bhaai bhagatee dekh preetam kaam krodh nivaariaa ||
lines.translation: Seeing His bride's loving devotion, the Beloved Lord eradicates unfulfilled sexual desire and unresolved anger.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੁੰਧ ਨਵੇਲ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਸਾਧਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak mu(n)dh navel su(n)dar dekh pir saadhaariaa ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the young, innocent bride is so beautiful; seeing her Husband Lord, she is comforted. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਨਵੇਲੜੀਏ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਬਾਲੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach navelaReee joban baalee raam ||
lines.translation: Truthfully, O young soul-bride, your youth keeps you innocent.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਉ ਨ ਜਾਉ ਕਹੀ ਅਪਨੇ ਸਹ ਨਾਲੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: aau na jaau kahee apane sah naalee raam ||
lines.translation: Do not come and go anywhere; stay with your Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਹ ਅਪਨੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਦਾਸੀ ਮੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: naah apane sa(n)g daasee mai bhagat har kee bhaavae ||
lines.translation: I will stay with my Husband Lord; I am His hand-maiden. Devotional worship to the Lord is pleasing to me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥੀਐ ਸਹਜਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: agaadh bodh akath katheeai sahaj prabh gun gaavae ||
lines.translation: I know the unknowable, and speak the unspoken; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Celestial Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਸਾਲ ਰਸੀਆ ਰਵੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਿਆਰੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam rasaal raseeaa ravai saach piaareeaa ||
lines.translation: She who chants and savors the taste of the Lord's Name is loved by the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਦੀਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਕੀਆ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gur sabad deeaa daan keeaa naanakaa veechaareeaa ||2||
lines.translation: The Guru grants her the gift of the Shabad; O Nanak, she contemplates and reflects upon it. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਮੋਹਿਅੜੀ ਪਿਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੂਤੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: sreedhar mohiaRee pir sa(n)g sootee raam ||
lines.translation: She who is fascinated by the Supreme Lord, sleeps with her Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਚਲੋ ਸਾਚਿ ਸੰਗੂਤੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai bhaai chalo saach sa(n)gootee raam ||
lines.translation: She walks in harmony with the Guru's Will, attuned to the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਸਾਚਿ ਸੰਗੂਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੂਤੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan saach sa(n)gootee har sa(n)g sootee sa(n)g sakhee saheleeaa ||
lines.translation: The soul-bride is attuned to the Truth, and sleeps with the Lord, along with her companions and sister soul-brides.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਭਾਇ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹਮ ਮੇਲੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik bhaai ik man naam vasiaa satiguroo ham meleeaa ||
lines.translation: Loving the One Lord, with one-pointed mind, the Naam dwells within; I am united with the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਚਸਾ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: din rain ghaRee na chasaa visarai saas saas nira(n)jano ||
lines.translation: Day and night, with each and every breath, I do not forget the Immaculate Lord, for a moment, even for an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਾਇ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੋ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sabad jot jagaai deepak naanakaa bhau bha(n)jano ||3||
lines.translation: So light the lamp of the Shabad, O Nanak, and burn away your fear. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਾਇੜੀਏ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: jot sabaaiReee tribhavan saare raam ||
lines.translation: O soul-bride, the Lord's Light pervades all the three worlds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghat ghat rav rahiaa alakh apaare raam ||
lines.translation: He is pervading each and every heart, the Invisible and Infinite Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਆਪੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: alakh apaar apaar saachaa aap maar milaaeeai ||
lines.translation: He is Invisible and Infinite, Infinite and True; subduing his self-conceit, one meets Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਲੋਭੁ ਜਾਲਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai mamataa lobh jaalahu sabad mail chukaaeeai ||
lines.translation: So burn away your egotistical pride, attachment and greed, with the Word of the Shabad; wash away your filth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਕਰੀ ਭਾਣੈ ਤਾਰਿ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dar jaai darasan karee bhaanai taar taaranahaariaa ||
lines.translation: When you go to the Lord's Door, you shall receive the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; by His Will, the Savior will carry you across and save you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਚਾਖਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har naam a(n)mrit chaakh tripatee naanakaa ur dhaariaa ||4||1||
lines.translation: Tasting the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Name, the soul-bride is satisfied; O Nanak, she enshrines Him in her heart. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਘਣਾ ਸਾਚਿ ਵਿਗਾਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai man chaau ghanaa saach vigaasee raam ||
lines.translation: My mind is filled with such a great joy; I have blossomed forth in Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: mohee prem pire prabh abinaasee raam ||
lines.translation: I am enticed by the love of my Husband Lord, the Eternal, Imperishable Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਵਿਗਤੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਥੁ ਨਾਥਹ ਤਿਸੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: avigato har naath naathah tisai bhaavai so theeai ||
lines.translation: The Lord is everlasting, the Master of masters. Whatever He wills, happens.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੀਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤੂੰ ਜੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: kirapaal sadaa daiaal daataa jeeaa a(n)dar too(n) jeeai ||
lines.translation: O Great Giver, You are always kind and compassionate. You infuse life into all living beings.
